XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Engine malfunction indicator light comes on with properly running vehicle
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: INJECTION | P064C | CONTROL UNIT | GLOW PLUGS | IGNITION | ON | MIL | YELLOW | INCANDESCENCE |

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Reliability level key

* low level : Reported by a garage mechanic; fault case not recorded by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Widespread occurrence of the fault, confirmed by service technicians and independent repairers.

*** high level : Confirmed fault, with a high degree of ‘recurrence’ reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Injection

  • Device: Glow plug control unit

  • Fault: Engine fault warning light illuminates whilst the vehicle is operating correctly

  • Errors detected by the self-diagnostic system: P064C (Glow plug control module – Fault)

  • Cause: Faulty glow plug control unit

• Action: Check that the glow plug control unit is functioning correctly and, if necessary, replace it

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: The component in question showed no visible faults and, following its replacement, no adjustments were required using diagnostic equipment, thereby permanently resolving the fault.
    The component is located in the engine compartment on the driver’s side, at the top inside the fuse box.
